name: Diplomatic Gifts
description: +10% to Persuasion Power in Diplomacy.
lore: No desire for independence can withstand the power of goodies.
upgrade: Upgrade: +5% more Persuasion Power in Diplomacy.

name: Ancient Idol
description: The hero ignores the restriction on using the same Magic School twice.
lore: Power flows from the idol’s stone eyes, coursing into the body of its owner.

name: Armor of Wonder
description: +2 Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
lore: This armor was worn by ancient warriors of the Church of the Sun when it was still in its infancy.

name: Celestial Sash of Bliss
description: +2 Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
lore: The sentinels have withdrawn from the pact, but the artifact remains.

name: Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment
description: +2 Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
lore: Many say this is the helm of Erathia’s founder, but could it be possible for it to have ended up on Jadame?

name: Lion's Shield of Courage
description: +2 Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
lore: In Jadame, the Alliance’s effect extends to all creatures, not just those part of the initial pact.

name: Sandals of the Saint
description: +2 Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
lore: Many are the pilgrims of the Light who wear these sandals as a gesture of humility.

name: Sword of Judgement
description: +2 Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
lore: The Angelic Alliance was formed as a symbol of unity between sentinels of glory and mortals. Rumor has is that other such alliances exist in far away lands.

name: Banner of Six Winds
description: +1 Speed to friendly creatures.
lore: There used to be a seventh wind, but he displeased Arina. And then there were six.

name: Chitinous Shield
description: +12 Defense, but –4 Attack.
lore: Their shells are as hard as crystal.

name: Demon Claw
description: +12 Attack, but –4 Defense.
lore: They say Beelzebub’s hands are soft as silk, but not those of his minions.

name: Boreoloth's Tail
description: +1 Defense.
lore: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self-improvement.
upgrade: Upgrade: +1 more Defense. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Boreoloth's Hand
description: +1 Attack.
lore: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self-improvement.
upgrade: Upgrade: +1 more Attack. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Boreoloth's Head
description: +1 Knowledge.
lore: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self-improvement.
upgrade: Upgrade: +1 more Knowledge. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Boreoloth's Heart
description: +1 Spell Power.
lore: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self-improvement.
upgrade: Upgrade: +1 more Spell Power. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Caduceus
description: Heroic Strike restores 4 mana.
lore: With this, blood can become magic, and matter can become spirit.

name: Chained Priestesses
description: A group of the Temple’s priestesses, seized for necromantic rites.
lore: By guiding the weak and wounded to final peace, the Necromancers of Jadame serve all the continent’s nations.

name: Injured Priestesses
description: A group of the Temple’s priestesses, rescued from a grim fate.
lore: No mortal force should decide who is to live — or to die.

name: Phoenix Egg
description: Something has halted the phoenix’s rebirth.
lore: A silence where fire should rise.

name: Blob of Red
description: Mysterious floating liquid.

name: Deck of Spells
description: Makes all tier-1 spells available to the hero.
lore: Some wizards enjoyed games and gambling a bit too much. This is the result.

name: Daylight Tome
description: Allows the hero to cast all Daylight spells.
lore: “Arina the Brave, Justice of the Heavens, Sister of Sunlight that reveals all and strikes true…”

name: Nightshade Tome
description: Allows the hero to cast all Nightshade spells.
lore: “Naira the True, the Gentle, Knower of Secrets, Muffler of Steps: wrap me in your wings of silence…”

name: Primal Tome
description: Allows the hero to cast all Primal spells.
lore: “Hksmilla, World’s Rage, Primal Eye; unlike any other scholar, with your thousand claws and multiple heads...”

name: Arcane Tome
description: Allows the hero to cast all Arcane spells.
lore: “Doreath the Pure, Weaver of the world’s clearest essence, Master of Time, Space, and Solitude…”

name: Chain Link
description: Forbids the wearer and the enemy hero to cast tier-1 and 2 spells in combat.
lore: A link from a Concubus chain worn around the finger. It’s seen a lot.

name: Chain Mail
description: +3 Defense.
lore: Basic torso protection. Takes way too long to make for its mediocre defense.

name: Robe of Enlightenment
description: Makes all tier-3 spells available to the hero.
lore: A wizard once noticed an odd resemblance between weaving and spellcraft. As a result, these robes were created.

name: Crown of the Supreme Magi
description: +4 Knowledge.
lore: They say it drives the wearer mad over time.
upgrade: Upgrade: +2 more Knowledge. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Demonic Heart
description: Replaces all the hero’s spells with their Masterful versions (if they exist).
lore: Everyone has all the power of the world in their heart. You just need to tune to the Chorus’s buzz to find it.

name: Buckler
description: Friendly creatures can counterattack even if the attacking enemy has “Swift Strike.”
lore: Made not for defense, but to better position yourself for counterattacking.
upgrade: Upgrade: Friendly creatures deal +5% Melee Damage.

name: Rapier
description: Friendly creatures deal +10% Melee Damage
lore: A light, stinging weapon. A tool for elegant fighters.

name: Eagle Armor
description: +2 Morale and Luck.

name: Flask of Oblivion
description: All negative effects on friendly creatures last for –1 round(s).
lore: Water brings oblivion. It can erase memories of pain and trouble.

name: Lifeblood Fae
description: Friendly creatures have +2 HP.
lore: The fae know unique blood magic. They also remember the face of everyone who has ever held them captive.

name: Ring of Life
description: All positive effects on friendly creatures last for +1 round(s).
lore: Made of silverwort, a unique herb that feels like metal.

name: Endless Bag
description: Produces +1 Gem, Crystal, or Mercury daily. (The resource depends on the bearer’s faction.)
lore: Adventurers all over the world throw their possessions into these bags. It’s about time someone began to fish them out.

name: Crescent Dagger
description: Spells and creature abilities ignore 40% of enemy magic resistance.
lore: If spells are written in the stars, the crescent moon is there to cut them to pieces.

name: Magic Slippers
description: Spells cost 2 less mana.
lore: Not the most comfortable, but definitely very magical.

name: Vortex Robe
description: Whenever the opponent casts a spell, restores 40% of its cost as mana to the wearer.
lore: If you look at it for too long, you’ll feel as though it’s sucking you in.
upgrade: Upgrade: Restores 60% of the spell’s cost.

name: Excalibur
description: Heroic Strike kills +1 unit(s). Works on creatures up to tier 7.
lore: No scale, armor, or shield can offer protection against this blade.

name: Fine Wand
description: +1 level to all spells.
lore: Wands are used to focus mental projections, just as crystals focus light into beams.

name: Flag of Truce
description: The wearer keeps their army whenever they flee from battle.
lore: No matter how powerful you are on the battlefield, in the end all disputes are solved politically.

name: Garotte
description: –1 Speed to all enemies.
lore: Can’t do much when you’re choking.

name: Emerald Resonance Controller
description: –10% to enemy hero Spell Power. Friendly creatures are immune to the effects that kill additional units.
lore: Magic is the art of resonance — which means discordant vibration can dampen it.

name: Golden Goose Egg
description: Grants a random wondrous reward after a random number of upgrades.
lore: If we knew for certain how golden geese are hatched, we’d live like kings. But there doesn’t seem to be a pattern.

name: Head Torch
description: +1 sight radius.
lore: Surprisingly, it was the templars who invented it, not the dwarves. They required even more of the guiding light.

name: Holy Sigil of Eridore
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Logistics, Battle Magic, Wisdom.
lore: A fictional deity invented by pixies as a prank, Eridore would later be worshipped by many seeking to bless their messages.

name: Holy Sigil of Mearea
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Luck, Economy, Daylight Magic.
lore: The golden dragon of myth is said to bring wealth so great that it eventually became a symbol of worship.

name: Holy Sigil of Quix
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Arcane Magic, Scouting, Battlecraft, Thaumaturgy.
lore: A conqueror who was said to have never died, but instead ventured to conquer new worlds beyond this one, Quix exists now only in legend.

name: Holy Sigil of Roph
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Righteousness, Necromancy, Murmuring, Triumvirate’s Strength, Abyssal Communion, Summon Swarm.
lore: No one remembers who Roph once served, but he did so with unwavering loyalty. In time, he became a local saint, embodying the ideals of steadfast devotion to one’s sovereign, one’s faction, and oneself.

name: Holy Sigil of The Seven Magi
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Sorcery, Nightshade Magic, Resistance.
lore: Seven powerful mages formed a secret coven. It’s no longer in existence, but their Sigil endures.

name: Holy Sigil of Uurdt
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Defense, Primal Magic, Recruitment.
lore: “Where blood spills, plants grow.” This was the motto of an ancient druidic cult, and only their sigil remains to tell their tale.

name: Fancy Mask
description: Generates 2 Focus Point(s) at the start of the battle.
lore: Tell me what mask you wear, and I will tell you who you want to be.

name: Music Sheet
description: Friendly creatures’ abilities deal +40% Damage.
lore: Music helps one articulate themselves — and sets the battle rhythm.

name: Singing Pan-Pipe
description: All effects applied by friendly creatures last +1 round(s).

name: Armet
description: +2 Defense.

name: Drum of War
description: Friendly creatures deal +1 Damage.

name: Lance
description: +3 Attack.

name: Misericorde
description: +2 Attack.
lore: Ending an opponent’s suffering swiftly is a mercy.

name: Plate Armor
description: +3 Defense.
lore: Sticks and stones may break bones, but not through full armor.

name: Legion's Leg
description: +50% to all creature growth in all your cities.
lore: Somewhere, a legless statue is waiting sorrowfully.

name: Light-and-Shade Cloak
description: Friendly creatures can still use Ranged attacks while adjacent to enemy creatures.
lore: Makes the wearer dissolve into the dance of light and shade.
upgrade: Upgrade: Friendly creatures deal +5% Ranged Damage.

name: Quivering Quiver
description: Friendly creatures deal +10% Ranged Damage.
lore: Grows magic arrows, bolts, darts, shuriken, javelins, and any throwing item imaginable. (Thank the woods.)

name: Shroomwood Bow
description: Eliminates Ranged Damage penalty for friendly creatures.
lore: This living bow grows new arrows itself.
upgrade: Upgrade: Friendly creatures deal +5% Ranged Damage.

name: Lord's Ring
description: Friendly creatures have +1 Initiative.
lore: When your lord commands, you get up and go. Simple as that.

name: Magic Key Ring
description: Negates all effects that restrict creature rearrangement, surrendering, fleeing, and using the Spellbook and hero abilities in battle.
lore: Can unlock the Shackles of War.

name: Golden Moth
description: +250 Gold daily.
lore: They say moths burn themselves mistaking light for gold, for such is their attraction to riches. And so for her husband’s greed, Duke Milos’s wife was turned into a moth.

name: Golden Pig
description: +500 Gold daily.
lore: They say pigs are so greedy they dig the ground constantly in search for gold. And so for his own greed, Duke Milos was turned into a pig.

name: Skull of Milos
description: +1000 Gold daily.
lore: They say gold doesn’t care if you’re guilty or innocent. And so for his master’s greed Duke Milos’s most loyal servant was imprisoned in a golden skull.

name: Monster Head
description: All creatures always have neutral Morale in battle.
lore: Can’t be too cheerful when the opponent flaunts their trophies like that.

name: Mythic Magic Scroll
description: Adds the “Dimension Door” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Mythic Magic Scroll
description: Adds the “Gate of Light” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Mythic Magic Scroll
description: Adds the “Pocket Dimension” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Mythic Magic Scroll
description: Adds the “Second Wind” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Mythic Magic Scroll
description: Adds the “Shadowflight” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Mythic Magic Scroll
description: Adds the “Town Portal” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Omencaller
description: –1 to enemy Luck.
lore: An imp on your shoulder spells bad luck… for the enemy.

name: Fish-to-the-Face
description: +1 Attack.

name: Last Coin
description: +1 Luck.

name: Rags
description: +1 Spell Power.
lore: Don’t judge what makes others feel empowered!

name: Rope Belt
description: +1 Defense.

name: Straw Hat
description: +1 Knowledge.
lore: The fool is sometimes the smartest man in the village.

name: Wooden Ring
description: +1 Morale.

name: Crown of Dragontooth
description: +4 Spell Power and Knowledge.
lore: There’s much wisdom to be found in a dragon’s wisdom teeth.

name: Dragon Scale Armor
description: +4 Attack and Defense.
lore: The black dragons of Alvar are relatively fine with seeing their green brethren skinned. The ashen dragons of Alvar are completely fine with it.

name: Dragon Scale Shield
description: +3 Attack and Defense.
lore: Some call fashioning arms from dragon hide blasphemy. But such critiques can’t be heard over the sound of its superior protection.

name: Dragon Wing Tabard
description: +2 Spell Power and Knowledge.
lore: Zero wings were harmed in the making of this tabard.

name: Dragonbone Greaves
description: +1 Spell Power and Knowledge.
lore: Just don’t venture into Alvar, Garrote Gorge, or any other land ruled by dragons wearing them.

name: Quiet Eye of a Dragon
description: +1 Attack and Defense.
lore: You can’t shake the feeling that it follows you wherever you go.

name: Red Dragon Flame Tongue
description: +2 Attack and Defense.
lore: Forged with the breath of a true dragon.

name: Slithering Sash
description: +3 Spell Power and Knowledge.
lore: The eye may be fake, crafted from a jewel, but the slithering is very much real.

name: Ring of Neutrality
description: All creatures always have neutral Luck in battle.
lore: Chances can be calculated — and neutralized.

name: Liquid Silence
description: +1 round(s) to the cooldown of all enemy creature abilities.
lore: A common tool of negotiation in Alvar court.

name: Amelchia's Law
description: –1 Initiative to enemy creatures.
lore: It becomes incredibly hard to do something when the Queen of Alvar forbids it.

name: Truthmaker
description: –10% Attack to enemy creatures.
lore: Truth is what you make it. And if reality doesn’t agree, remind it who’s the strongest here.

name: Truthseeker
description: –10% Defense to enemy creatures.
lore: To find out the truth, first find their softest, most vulnerable spot.

name: Runestone Shards
description: Makes all tier-2 spells available to the hero.
lore: Just these few shards hold vast knowledge, suggesting they may have once been part of something much greater.

name: Scholar's Amulet
description: +2 Knowledge.
lore: For those who know that they know nothing.

name: Scholar's Tiara
description: +2 Knowledge.
lore: To mark those willing to learn — and to aid them in doing so.

name: Seal of Silence
description: +1 round(s) to the cooldown of all enemy spells.
lore: It does more than prevent speech; it saps the very desire to resist.

name: Seven-League Boots
description: +30 Movement points.
lore: A little month; or ere those shoes grew old. And their trail stretched long.

name: Dark Hatchet
description: +4 Attack, then +15% total Attack.
lore: Perfect for mincing meat and not mincing words.

name: Iridescent Cloak
description: +6 Knowledge.
lore: Murmurwood casters rarely read, relying instead on memory for their mystical knowledge.

name: Shaman Staff
description: +6 Spell Power.
lore: The focusing gem isn’t crafted but naturally grown on the branch.

name: Sixth Finger
description: –1 to enemy Morale and Luck.
lore: King Elloran was said to have cursed touch. Even now his finger brings misfortune, so long as you let it grow into your hand.

name: Soulless Sash
description: –1 Morale to enemy creatures.
lore: As opposed to all the other sashes that are so notorious for having souls.

name: Soulcaller Ring
description: The enemy loses 1 levels on all Magic School spells.
lore: Summoned from beyond the veil, they gladly aid in supressing your enemies — for they know that one day it will be your turn to repay their price.

name: Spells in Bottles
description: Makes all tier-4 spells available to the hero.
lore: Potions have existed for a long time, but to bottle the very knowledge needed to cast a spell? That is truly an impressive feat.

name: Spyglass
description: +2 sight radius.
lore: I spy with my little eye something beginning with the eye of a storm.

name: Swamp Boots
description: Eliminates all terrain penalties.
lore: They also work as Snow Boots, Desert Boots, Deathland Boots, etc.

name: Shield of the Rampaging Ogre
description: +4 Defense.
lore: ...Why would a rampaging ogre need a shield?
upgrade: Upgrade: +2 more Defense. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Mirror Tiara
description: Restores 8 mana to the hero each morning.
lore: When crafted into jewelry and worn near the head, tranquil glass reveals its true power.

name: Magic Mirror
description: Restores 4 mana to the hero each morning.
lore: This mirror has an uncanny ability to restore its own broken shards.

name: Shard of Serenity
description: Restores 6 mana to the hero each morning.
lore: A ring crafted from a stray shard of tranquil glass retains some of its calming properties.

name: Two-faced Mask
description: The hero can use the Spellbook 1 additional time(s) per battle round.
lore: The inscription reads, “Divide your visage, and you shall never face battle alone.”

name: Tabar Signet-Ring
description: +1 Luck.
lore: “Tabar” means “novelty” in the Sacred Vori Language. Combined, “Ukhtabar” means “the joy of novelty.”

name: Ukh Signet
description: +1 Morale.
lore: “Ukh” means “joy” in the Sacred Vori Language. Combined, “Ukhtabar” means “the joy of novelty.”

name: Voodoo Doll
description: When the wearer is defeated, they can still be hired back in the Tavern.
lore: And what a lovely community awaits them there!

name: Backpack
description: The hero has +10 Movement points.
lore: Yes, you can wear it over that fancy cape.

name: Boots of Travel
description: +10 Movement points.
lore: Nothing beats soft leather for travelling long distances.

name: Warlord Boots
description: +2 Initiative to friendly creatures.
lore: Can’t stand in one place — need to act!

name: Warrior's Belt
description: +2 Attack.
lore: Any warrior can appreciate a good belt to hang their sword on.

name: Wizard's Cloak
description: +2 Spell Power.
lore: It magically blocks out distractions, allowing the wizard to focus solely on their spellcraft.

name: Wizard's Amulet
description: +2 Spell Power.
lore: Even if the wearer is lacking, the power within this amulet more than compensates for it.

name: Heartbeat
description: +12 Spell Power, but –4 Knowledge.
lore: Just feel the rhythm of the Chorus.

name: Tunic of the Cyclops King
description: +4 Spell Power.
lore: This is where his second eye is.
upgrade: Upgrade: +2 more Spell Power. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Ribcage Armor
description: +4 Defense, then +15% total Defense.
lore: Honestly, it’s not that much deader than a reanimated skeleton.

name: Fallen Angel Wings
description: Grants constant flight.
lore: They whisper that the true angels abandoned the Temple of the Sun. Was it the Templars’ zealotry — or the angels’ hubris?

name: Second Shade
description: +4 Knowledge, then +15% total Knowledge.
lore: It has an eerie aura of thinking for you.

name: Bone Boots
description: +4 Spell Power, then +15% total Spell Power.

name: Beelzebub's Boon
description: +12 Knowledge, but –4 Spell Power.
lore: A new force in this world, Beelzebub sought a way to ensure his summoning would never end.

name: Seven Eyes
description: +1 level(s) to all spells while worn.
lore: Connecting directly to the brain, these eyes access an entirely new layer of knowledge.

name: Sirin Mask
description: The cooldowns of all spells are reduced by 1 round(s).
lore: Owls and sirins know everything — whether they choose to share it is another matter.

name: Spellbinder's Hat
description: Makes all tier-5 spells available to the hero.
lore: Legendary among wizards, this hat is the dream of every mage on Enroth.

name: Orb of Inhibition
description: On the first round of the battle, heroes cannot use their Spellbook or active abilities.
lore: It’s strange to behold, as though within this orb light and sound do not exist.

name: Orb of Destruction
description: Heroic Strike deals +10 base Damage.
lore: It will take all that you are and turn it into raw power.

name: Tactical Guide
description: The opponent cannot rearrange creatures before the start of battle.
lore: 22… Ra4 23. Nc3 Ra8 24. Nb5 Ra4 25. Nc3 Ra8 26. Nb5.

name: Orb of Twilight
description: All of the hero’s Nightshade spells have +1 level(s). Enemy hero has –1 Nightshade spell level.
lore: Nightshade magic is subtle, specializing in negative effects, mind-reading, and manipulation.

name: Orb of Dawn
description: All of the hero’s Daylight spells have +1 level(s). Enemy hero has –1 Daylight spell level.
lore: Daylight magic is relentless, excelling in positive effects, cleansing, defense, and attack.

name: Orb of Eternity
description: All of the hero’s Arcane spells have +1 level(s). Enemy hero has –1 Arcane spell level.
lore: Arcane magic is elusive, capable of bending time, space, and raw energy to its will.

name: Primordial Orb
description: All of the hero’s Primal spells have +1 level(s). Enemy hero has –1 Primal spell level.
lore: Primal magic is raw and untamed, focusing mostly on elemental assaults.

name: Warrior's Amulet
description: +2 Attack.
lore: The mark of many martial feats accomplished — and many more to come.

name: Keeper's Amulet
description: +2 Defense.
lore: This amulet allows the wearer to survive against all odds — though sadly, it’s worn by cowards who never intend to face such dangers.

name: Pelagic Hourglass
description: The cooldowns of all spells are reduced by 1 round(s).

name: Shoddy Shield
description: +2 Defense.
lore: It may be just a plank of wood, but at least it’s sturdy wood.

name: Ogre's Club of Havoc
description: +4 Attack.
lore: Coincidentally, the ogres of Ironsand also have a club where they wreak havoc.
upgrade: Upgrade: +2 more Attack. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

name: Brass Knuckles
description: Friendly creatures take –30% counterattack Damage.

name: Crimson Resonance Controller
description: –20% to enemy hero Spell Power. Friendly creatures are immune to effects that prevent them from attacking.
lore: Magic is the art of resonance — which means discordant vibration can dampen it.
upgrade: Upgrade: –10% more to enemy Spell Power.

name: Clenching Ring
description: All effects applied by the hero last +1 round(s).
lore: This ring helps one cling to incantations as effortlessly as birds cling to branches in their sleep.

name: Keeper's Ring
description: +2 Defense.
lore: City guards often wear these rings to help them react to danger one or two seconds faster.

name: Holy Sigil of Insara
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Leadership, Insight, Diplomacy, Tactics.
lore: Legend speaks of an oracle who could foresee the outcomes of wars and battles. Over time, generals began to revere her name.

name: Enchanted Magic Scroll
description: Adds the max. level “Carapace” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Automated Antimagic Shield
description: –10% Magic Damage taken. Friendly creatures are immune to the effects of “Berserk.”
lore: Dwarves deal with the elements so much, they’ve automated their defenses.

name: Protective Belt
description: –10% Magic Damage taken. Friendly creatures are immune to the effects of “Sleep.”
lore: Not to be confused with conveyor belts. (Unless…)

name: Holy Sigil of The Second Man
description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Offense, Summon Avatar, Siegecraft, Combat.
lore: The First Man in existence is said to have found death, conquered by the power of the Second. At least, that is what the legends tell.

name: Magic Scroll
description: Adds the “Carapace” spell to the hero’s Spellbook.

name: Pole Star
description: Global Map spells of the hero cost 0 mana.
lore: They say stars are the tears of heaven. And tears can be drunk.

name: Shackles of War
description: Prevents surrender and flee in battle. (This affects both the wearer and their opponent.)
lore: Should have gone with the Lasso of War to catch the mount, too.

name: Ambassador's Sash
description: +10% to Persuasion Power in Diplomacy.
lore: They’ll follow you if you look pretty!
upgrade: Upgrade: +5% more Persuasion Power in Diplomacy.
